messages:
maria_cs: quick tideway onboarding health check — spotted a few tail regressions this week, wanted to surface p95/p99 split by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming so we can prioritize.

maria_cs: high level: usage +18% WoW, overall errors steady, but two routes show p99 regressions when streaming is enabled. spend bumped ~12% (more retries). attaching concise table below.

maria_cs: ```
Route            | Model                 | Mode         | p95 (ms) | p99 (ms)
onboard-chat     | redwood/fast-7b       | streaming     | 220      | 480
onboard-chat     | redwood/fast-7b       | non-streaming | 180      | 230
classify         | gptx-13b-quant        | streaming     | 300      | 1200 <-- outlier
classify         | gptx-13b-quant        | non-streaming | 260      | 340
ingest-embeds    | sentence-transformer  | non-streaming | 120      | 150
```

noah_sre: thanks — flagged node pool p99s on the classify streaming path. seeing KV cache misses + repeated full-attention kernels around 12:10–12:40 UTC yesterday.

maria_cs: thanks @noah_sre. sample request ids I pulled: rid_tdw_001, rid_tdw_027, rid_tdw_089. they map to the big p99 spike.

noah_sre: ack — I'll tail logs for those IDs and check hot-shard metrics. initial hunch: batcher weight + quantized kernel mismatch causing long tail.

ashley_eng: if kernel fallback is happening that would explain 4x p99. can we temporarily route classify streaming to the non-streaming path (or to redwood/fast-7b) while we debug? @maria_cs is that acceptable for Tideway UX?

maria_cs: Tideway okay with a brief fallback for classify — they prefer consistency over streaming interactivity for onboarding flows. do it.

ashley_eng: plan: 1) add route-level policy to prefer non-streaming for /classify for next 6h, 2) add canary to redirect 10% to redwood/fast-7b, 3) collect p95/p99 + error delta. I'll open a quick rollout.

deploy_bot: Deployment started: rollout-id=rl-2026-03-21-42, target=/classify policy change -> prefer non-streaming, canary=10%.

noah_sre: after rollout started, I'm seeing immediate drop in p99 for classify from ~1200ms -> ~340ms on canary. will validate across nodes.

sam_finance: noted spend spike tied to retries on streaming classify — if rollback to non-streaming holds, projected spend delta returns to baseline and monthly commit stays intact.

maria_cs: action items: 
- noah_sre: investigate kernels + KV cache miss root cause, report by EOD (owner)
- ashley_eng: monitor rollout telemetry and confirm p95/p99 for 6h canary, revert or expand based on results (owner)
- sam_finance: update Tideway billing note and confirm finance impact with account exec (owner)

ashley_eng: small note — add a quick metric to console: per-route streaming-fallback-rate so CS can watch these in future.

maria_cs: agreed. can we have an alert when p99 > 500ms for any onboarding route? even a transient one.

noah_sre: will add alert rule: p99_onboard_routes > 500ms for 5m -> page oncall.

maria_cs: thanks all. I'll sync with customer and post a short update after 6h check. :thumbsup:

ashley_eng: TL;DR: temporary policy change to non-streaming for /classify + 10% canary to smaller model, early results look good. follow-ups: kernel root cause and dashboard tile for fallback-rate.

maria_cs: end.
